name: ONLYOFFICE
description: This plugin allows users to edit office documents from Mattermost using ONLYOFFICE Docs.

settings_schema.header:
**Welcome to ONLYOFFICE Docs!**
Open, edit, and co-author office documents in your Mattermost chats using ONLYOFFICE Docs.
[**Learn more**](https://helpcenter.onlyoffice.com/integration/mattermost.aspx)   [**Suggest a feature**](https://feedback.onlyoffice.com/forums/966080-your-voice-matters?category_id=519288)
settings_schema.footer:
**ONLYOFFICE Docs Cloud**
Easily launch the editors in the cloud without downloading and installation
 
[**Get now**](https://www.onlyoffice.com/docs-registration.aspx?referer=mattermost)

settings.help_text: ONLYOFFICE Docs Location specifies the address of the server with the document services installed. Please change the '<documentserver>' for the server address in the below line.
Use the auto-generated JWT secret key or set your own here and the same one in the ONLYOFFICE Docs config file.

settings.display_name: Connection to demo ONLYOFFICE Docs server enabled:

settings.help_text: When enabled, only file owners can protect/unprotect files. When disabled, file protection is disabled for everyone.
When enabled, users can use ONLYOFFICE plugins in the editor. When disabled, the plugins interface is hidden.
When enabled, users can create and run macros in documents. When disabled, macros functionality is hidden.
